/** TreeNode representation of an immutable DataRecord item.
 * 
 *  Calling setUserObject will not change the corresponding
 *  DataRecord object's information, but only that of this TreeNode.
 *  
 * @author ?
 * Removed, then added back credit on 05/13/22 6:15 AM (vincent)
 */
@SuppressWarnings("serial")
class TreeModelNode 
    extends DefaultMutableTreeNode {
    
    
    protected boolean visible;
    protected ArrayList<TreeModelNode> children;
    protected boolean hasLoadedVisibleChildren;

    TreeModelNode(DataRecord userObject,Enumeration<? extends TreeNode> children) {
        super(userObject);
        visible=true;
        this.children = new ArrayList<TreeModelNode>();
        for(TreeNode n : (Iterable<TreeNode>)() -> children) {
            this.children.add((TreeModelNode)n);
        }
    }
    
    TreeModelNode() {
        this(null,new TreeModelNode[0]);
    }
    
    boolean isVisible() { return this.visible; }
    
    void setVisible(boolean visible) { this.visible = visible; }
    
    
    /**
     * Use custom collection of visible children rather than the 
     * whole lot of children in the superclass.
     * 
     */
    @SuppressWarnings({ "rawtypes" })
    @Override
    public Enumeration children() {
        
        if(!hasLoadedVisibleChildren) {
            if(children==null) {
                children=new ArrayList<>();
            }
        
            for(Enumeration e=super.children();e.hasMoreElements();) {
                TreeModelNode child=(TreeModelNode)e.nextElement();
                if(child.isVisible())
                    children.add(child);
            }
            
            hasLoadedVisibleChildren=true;
        }
        
        return new VetoableNodeEnumeration(children);
        
    }
    


    public void resetVisible() {
        
        log.trace(".resetVisible()");
        
        // make sure that the children collection isn't cached any longer
        hasLoadedVisibleChildren=false;
        
        Enumeration<?> e=super.children();

        while(e.hasMoreElements()) {
            ((TreeModelNode)e.nextElement()).resetVisible();
        }
    }
    
    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see javax.swing.tree.DefaultMutableTreeNode#insert(javax.swing.tree.MutableTreeNode, int)
     */
    @Override
    public void insert(MutableTreeNode newChild, int childIndex) {
        super.insert(newChild, childIndex);
        
        // mark for re-calculation / generation of visible children array
        hasLoadedVisibleChildren=false;
    }
  

    TreeModelNode[] computeChildren(final TreeModelNode parent) {
        
        log.trace("computing visible children");

        Object specificationObject=parent.getUserObject();
      
        if(specificationObject instanceof String) {
            final String v=(String)specificationObject;
            
            final Map<String,TreeModelNode> categories=new TreeMap<>();
            final Map<String,TreeModelNode> items=new TreeMap<>();
            for(Enumeration e=super.children();e.hasMoreElements();) {
        
                TreeModelNode node=(TreeModelNode)e.nextElement();
                
                if(node.getUserObject()==null) {
                    System.err.println("[WARNINNG] unprocessed node: " + node);
                    continue;
                }
                
                if(node.getUserObject() instanceof String) {
                    categories.put(node.getUserObject().toString(), node);
                }
                
                if(node.getUserObject() instanceof ODDataRecord) {
                    ODDataRecord record=(ODDataRecord)node.getUserObject();
                    items.put(record.toString(), node);
                }
            }
            
            final COAFilter option=set.getFilter();
            for(ODDataRecord record : set.getDataRecords()) {
                
                if(filterTest(v, record,option)) {
                    
                    log.trace("passed filter: " + record);
            
                    // find the tree node location to which children have to be added
                    TreeModelNode location=parent;
                    
                    final String categoryName=record.getCategory();
                    
                    if(option.group && categoryName!=null) {
                        location=categories.get(categoryName);
                        if(location==null) {
                            location=new TreeModelNode(categoryName,new TreeNode[0]);
                            categories.put(categoryName, location);
                            parent.add(location);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // create a new node:
                    TreeModelNode itemNode=new TreeModelNode(record, new DefaultMutableTreeNode[0]);
                    location.add(itemNode);
                    
             
                    // assure visible structure between inserted child 
                    // and desired parent node
                    ensureVisible(itemNode,parent);
                    
                } else {
                    log.trace("failed filter: " + record);
                }
                   
             
            }
            
        } 
        
        
        return (TreeModelNode[]) children.toArray(new TreeModelNode[children.size()]);
    }
    
    private boolean filterTest(final String currentCategory, final ODDataRecord r,COAFilter option) {
        
        if(option.nameContains!=null && option.nameContains.length()>0) {
            boolean has=false;
            
            if(r.getValueAsString(ODPConstants.ALIAS_NAME).toLowerCase().indexOf(option.nameContains)<0) {
                // Check if it is in the CV terms
                for(String keyword : r.getValueAsString(ODPConstants.CV_TERMS).toLowerCase().split(";")) {
                    if(keyword.startsWith(option.nameContains)) {
                        has=true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if(!has)
                    return false;
            }
        }
        
        
        // manage the "only side" options
        //
        if(option.leftOverOnly && currentCategory.contains("=") && r.getValueIdAsInt(ODPConstants.LEFT_OVER_PROP_BOOL)!=1) {
                return false;
        }
            
        if(option.unassignedOnly && !r.getValueAsBoolean(ODPConstants.CATEGORY_NOT_TO_BE_ASSIGNED)) {
                return false;
        }
   
        
        final int commonNameId=ODPConstants.getColumnDescForKey(
                                                    ODPConstants.COMMON_NAME).pos;
        
        if( (option.nameShow)?!(ODPConstants.humanCommonNames
                                                [commonNameId].equalsIgnoreCase(r.getValueAsString(ODPConstants.COMMON_NAME))) 
                             :ODPConstants.humanCommonNames[commonNameId].equalsIgnoreCase(r.getValueAsString(ODPConstants.COMMON_NAME)) ) {
            return false;
        }                                                
        
        // must be a "* node
        if(currentCategory.endsWith("-")) {
            
            // there is a category
            // verify that record has no category
            final String category=r.getCategory();
            if(category!=null && 
               !category.contains("<none>") && // legacy 
               !category.contains("user:") &&
               !category.contains("eshcol:") &&
               !category.contains("ESH:")) {
                return false;
            }
            
            // else fallthrough
        } 
        
        if(!currentCategory.endsWith("-") ) {
            // has a category
           
            // only allow records that have the same
            // category.
            //
            final String category=r.getCategory();     

            if(currentCategory!=null && category!=null && category.equals( currentCategory ) )
                return true;
            else
                return false;
        }
        
            
        return true;
    }

    
    /**
     * Ensure that all tree nodes between this node and specified parent
     * node are visible.
     * 
     * For example if the following nodes need to be made visible:
     * 
     * <pre>
     *    A
     *    |
     *    +--B
     *       |
     *       +--C
     * 
     * </pre>
     * @param leaf
     * @param parent
     */
    protected static void ensureVisible(DefaultMutableTreeNode leaf,
                                        DefaultMutableTreeNode parent) {
        
        // walk up
        if(leaf==parent)
            return;
        
        TreeModelNode n=(TreeModelNode)leaf;
        
        // ensures visibility frm leaf upwards.
        while(n.getParent()!=null) {
            n.setVisible(true);
            n=(TreeModelNode)n.getParent();
        }
        
        
    }
    
    
} // end of TreeNode class

/**
 * Sub-interface of Enumeration for use with TreeModelNode.
 * 
 * see java.util.Enumeration and
 * http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Filtering_composite
 * for more details.
 * 
 * @author Niels Bogaard
 */
                        
class VetoableNodeEnumeration 
    implements java.util.Enumeration<DefaultMutableTreeNode> {
    
    private final java.util.Iterator<TreeModelNode> nodes;
    
    VetoableNodeEnumeration(List<TreeModelNode> children) {
        this.nodes=children.iterator();
    }

    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see java.util.Enumeration#hasMoreElements()
     */
    @Override
    public boolean hasMoreElements() {
        return nodes.hasNext();
    }

    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see java.util.Enumeration#nextElement()
     */
    @Override
    public DefaultMutableTreeNode nextElement() {
        return nodes.next();
    }
 
}




class MyTreeModelListener extends TreeModelListenerAdapter {
    public static final org.apache.log4j.Logger logger = org.apache.log4j.Logger.getLogger(TreePane.class);
    private TreePane treePane;
    
    /**
     * Default constructor
     * @param tref
     */
    MyTreeModelListener(TreePane tref) {
        this.treePane = tref;
    }
    
    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see javax.swing.tree.TreeModelListener#treeNodesChanged(javax.swing.event.TreeModelEvent)
     */
    @Override
    public void treeNodesChanged(TreeModelEvent e) {
        super.treeNodesChanged(e);
                
        TreeModelNode source=(TreeModelNode)e.getTreePath().getLastPathComponent();
        int index=((Integer)e.getChildIndices()[0]).intValue();
        
        TreeModelNode child=(TreeModelNode)source.getChildAt(index);
         
        MutableTreeNode oldTarget=treePane.commonScoring.getRecordNode();
        removeNodes(child); 
        
        log.trace("treeNodeChanged Child: " + child);
        if(treePane.commonScoring!=null) {
            TreeNode placeholder=treePane.commonScoring.getNodeForRecord(child.getUserObject());
            if(placeholder!=null) {
                treePane.commonScoring.moveRecordNode(oldTarget,child);
            }
        }       
    }

    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see javax.swing.tree.TreeModelListener#treeNodesInserted(javax.swing.event.TreeModelEvent)
     */
    @Override
    public void treeNodesInserted(TreeModelEvent e) {
        super.treeNodesInserted(e);
                
    }

    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see javax.swing.tree.TreeModelListener#treeNodesRemoved(javax.swing.event.TreeModelEvent)
     */
    @Override
    public void treeNodesRemoved(TreeModelEvent e) {
        super.treeNodesRemoved(e);
               

                
    }

    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see javax.swing.tree.TreeModelListener#treeStructureChanged(javax.swing.event.TreeModelEvent)
     */
    @Override
    public void treeStructureChanged(TreeModelEvent e) {

        if(logger.isDebugEnabled()) {
            log.debug("treeStructureChanged():");
            for(TreePath path=e.getOldTreePath();path!=null;path=path.getParentPath()) 
                log.debug("" + path.toString() + "\n");
        }
        
        // determine the node that has been affected
        // by detecting which of the path nodes
        // has been invalidated.
        javax.swing.tree.TreeNode[] nodes=e.getPath();
        
        DefaultMutableTreeNode changedInRoot=(DefaultMutableTreeNode)nodes[nodes.length-1];
        
        log.debug("Changed in subtree: " + changedInRoot + " " + nodes[nodes.length-1]);
        
        DefaultTreeModel defaultTreeModel=
            (DefaultTreeModel)treePane.getModel();
        
        

        int selectedIndex=treePane.getSelectedRow();
        
        log.debug("selectedIndex: " + selectedIndex + " " + e.getOldLeadSelectionPath());
        
        if(selectedIndex!=-1) {
            DefaultMutableTreeNode node=
                (DefaultMutableTreeNode)
                getValueAt(selectedIndex);
            // log.debug("[selected: " + node);
            removeNodes(node);
        }
        
        
        // clear visible children array
        ((TreeModelNode)this.treePane.getModel().getRoot())
            .resetVisible();
        
        
        Object selectedPath=null;
        
        DefaultMutableTreeNode selected = 
            ((filteredTreeModel)defaultTreeModel).
            computeFilteredTree(
                (TreeModelNode)((filteredTreeModel)defaultTreeModel)
                .getRoot(),false
            );

        
        log.trace("selected: " + selected);
        
        // repaint tree view
        defaultTreeModel.nodeStructureChanged((TreeModelNode)defaultTreeModel.getRoot());
        
        // save / restore selection
        if(selectedPath!=null) {

            log.trace("restoring selected node at : " + selectedPath);
            
            DefaultMutableTreeNode unfilteredTreePathNode=(DefaultMutableTreeNode)selectedPath;
            DefaultMutableTreeNode filteredTreePathNode=
                (DefaultMutableTreeNode) ((filteredTreeModel)defaultTreeModel).nodeToFiltered.get(unfilteredTreePathNode);
        
            if(filteredTreePathNode!=null) {
                
                TreeModelEvent newEvent=new TreeModelEvent(this,new TreePath(
                    ((TreeNode)defaultTreeModel).
                        getPathToRoot(filteredTreePathNode)).pathByAddingChild(e.getChildren()[0]));
                
                log.trace("add treeSelectionListener option change: " + newEvent);
                
                this.treePane.mDocumentTree.setSelectionPath(
                        new TreePath(
                            defaultTreeModel.getPathToRoot(filteredTreePathNode)).
                        pathByAddingChild(e.getChildren()[0])
                        );
            } else {
                
                log.trace("Parent node (or nodeless branch) not found " +
                          "anymore, for event: " + e);
            }
            
        }
 
    }
    
    
    
    public Object getValueAt(int index) {
        
        Object l=treePane.mDocumentTree
                 .getPathForRow(index).getLastPathComponent();
        
        // log.trace(treePane.mDocumentTree.getModel().getTreePath())
        
        return l;
    }
    
    public void removeNodes(final DefaultMutableTreeNode node) {
        
        log.trace(".removeNodes(): will recursively remove from visible tree.");
        
        // check if node already is in filtered tree
        TreeModelNode correspondingNode=
            (TreeModelNode)
            ((filteredTreeModel)treePane.getModel()).
                nodeToFiltered.get(node);
            
        if(correspondingNode==null) { 
            
            log.debug("[ERR] node has no corresponding node: " + node);
           
        } else {
            ((filteredTreeModel)treePane.getModel()).
                    deleteNode(correspondingNode,false);
        }
    }


} // end of class TreeListener



abstract class TreeModelListenerAdapter implements TreeModelListener {


    /**
     * Repeats event to all submodel in the defaultModel
     *  
     * @param node
     * @param ev
     */
    protected void fireEventToAll(DefaultMutableTreeNode node,
                                  List<TreeModelListener> treeListeners,
                                  TreeModelEvent ev) {
        
        Object[] l=treeListeners.toArray();
        
        for(int i=0;i<l.length;i++) 
            ((TreeModelListener)l[i]).treeStructureChanged(ev);
    }

    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see javax.swing.tree.TreeModelListener#treeNodesChanged(javax.swing.event.TreeModelEvent)
     */
    @Override
    public abstract void treeNodesChanged(TreeModelEvent e);


    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see javax.swing.tree.TreeModelListener#treeNodesInserted(javax.swing.event.TreeModelEvent)
     */
    @Override
    public abstract void treeNodesInserted(TreeModelEvent e);

    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see javax.swing.tree.TreeModelListener#treeNodesRemoved(javax.swing.event.TreeModelEvent)
     */
    @Override
    public abstract void treeNodesRemoved(TreeModelEvent e);    

    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see javax.swing.tree.TreeModelListener#treeStructureChanged(javax.swing.event.TreeModelEvent)
     */
    @Override
    public abstract void treeStructureChanged(TreeModelEvent e); 
    

 /**
  * a debugging tool
  */
    public void print() {
        System.err.println("treeNodesChanged");
    }

}

/**
 * @param listener
 */
public void addTreeModelListener(Object listener) {

    Object enlightened=l;
    
    if(enlightened==null) {
        enlightened=this;
    }
    
        treeListeners.add(listener);

    }
} 
/** A class for handling events received by the JTree 
 * 
 * Extending TreeModelAdapter allows us to just override
 * those events we are interested in.
 * 
 * There should be one instance of this class for each root node
 * TODO - change this to a single instance.
 */
class MyTreeExpansionListener implements TreeExpansionListener {
    public static final org.apache.log4j.Logger logger = org.apache.log4j.Logger.getLogger(MyTreeExpansionListener.class);
    private final TreePane pane;
  
    
    public MyTreeExpansionListener(TreePane pane) {
        super();
        this.pane=pane;
    }
    
    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see javax.swing.event.TreeExpansionListener#treeExpanded(javax.swing.event.TreeExpansionEvent)
     */
    @Override
    public void treeExpanded(TreeExpansionEvent event) {
        
        
        DefaultTreeModel defaultTreeModel=(DefaultTreeModel) pane.getModel();
        
        log.trace("treeExpanded()");
        
        DefaultMutableTreeNode 
            expandedNode=
                (DefaultMutableTreeNode)
                   event.getPath().getLastPathComponent();
        
        final Object eo=expandedNode.getUserObject();
        
        // FIXME: is the default model the same as the actual
        //        tree's model on the TreePane? 
        if(defaultTreeModel.isLeaf(expandedNode))
            return;
        
        String objectString="";
        
        if(eo!=null)
            objectString=eo.toString();
        
        log.trace("Expanded node: " + expandedNode);

        if(!((TreeModelNode)expandedNode).isVisible()) {
            log.trace("Node is invisible, do not expand.");
            return;
        }
        
        Enumeration<TreeNode> e;
        log.trace("Has children: ");
        if ( expandedNode.children() != null) {
            filteredTreeModel m=
                (filteredTreeModel)
                   (filteredTreeModel)pane.getModel();
            
            ((TreeModelNode)expandedNode).resetVisible();
            
            ((TreeModelNode)expandedNode).
                children = 
                  new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(
                		  m.computeChildren(
                                (TreeModelNode)
                                expandedNode)));
        } else {
            
            DefaultMutableTreeNode node=
                new TreeModelNode("[EMPTY]",new TreeNode[0]);
            
            expandedNode.add(node);
        }
        
    }


    @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")
    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see javax.swing.event.TreeExpansionListener#treeCollapsed(javax.swing.event.TreeExpansionEvent)
     */
    @Override
    public void treeCollapsed(TreeExpansionEvent event) {
            
        log.trace("treeCollapsed()");
        
  
    }        
    
} // end of class MyExpansionListener



/** Generate a key for use in sorting nodes, 
 * by one or more columns.
 */
class TreeModelSorter {
    public static final org.apache.log4j.Logger logger = org.apache.log4j.Logger.getLogger(TreeModelSorter.class);


    /**
     * This is a composite key - it includes the path information.
     * 
     * Mostly flat, except for grouping
     * 
     * 
     * @param node
     * @param option
     * @return a unique key
     */
    public static String computeKey(DefaultMutableTreeNode node,final boolean longNames) {
        
         // the tree model needs a key to sort
        Object o=node.getUserObject();
     
        String result="";

        if(o instanceof ODDataRecord) {
            
            
            result=
                ((TreeModelNode) node).
                    getUserObject().toString();
        }else 
            if(o instanceof String) {
                result=
                   ( String)o;
                    
        } else {
            
            com.google.common.base.Objects.
            ToStringHelper helper=com.google.common.base.
                Objects
                .toStringHelper(TreeModelSorter.class);
            
            helper.addValue(o.toString());
            
            Object [] nodes=node.getPath();
            for(int jj=0;jj<nodes.length;jj++) {
    
                o=((DefaultMutableTreeNode)nodes[jj]).getUserObject();
                if(o!=null) {
                    if(o instanceof String || o instanceof ODDataRecord) {
                        helper.add("" +jj,
                                   computeKey((
                                       DefaultMutableTreeNode)nodes[jj],true));
                    }
           
                }
            }
            
            result=helper.toString();
        }
    
        if(longNames)
            return result;
        else
            return MiscUtils.computeSummary(result,10);
        
    }
    
    public static String computeValueKey(Object o,final boolean longNames) {
    
        Object r=((DefaultMutableTreeNode)o).getUserObject();
        return computeKey((DefaultMutableTreeNode)o,longNames);
        
    }
}
/**
 * A Mouse Listener for tree action events and 
 * registering column resize requests.
 * 
 */
class MyTreeMouseListener 
    extends MouseAdapter
    {

    protected TreePane owner;
    final static org.apache.log4j.Logger logger =
        org.apache.log4j.Logger.getLogger(TreePane.MyTreeMouseListener.class);
    
    
    MyTreeMouseListener(TreePane treePane) {
        this.owner=treePane;
    }
    
    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see java.awt.event.MouseAdapter#mouseClicked(java.awt.event.MouseEvent)
     */
    @Override
    public void mouseClicked(MouseEvent e) {
        super.mouseClicked(e);
        checkIfOtherSelected("mouseClicked");
    }
    
    
    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see java.awt.event.MouseAdapter#mousePressed(java.awt.event.MouseEvent)
     */
    @Override
    public void mousePressed(MouseEvent e) {
    	logger.trace("mousePressed");
        super.mouseClicked(e);
        checkIfOtherSelected("mousePressed");
    }        

    @SuppressWarnings("cast")
    private void checkIfOtherSelected(String source) {
    	

        
        int[] rows=this.owner.mDocumentTree.getSelectedRows();
        
        if(logger.isTraceEnabled()) {
        
            if(rows!=null && rows.length!=0) {
                log.trace(source + " selected rows: ");
                for(int k=0;k<Math.min(40,rows.length);k++) 
                    log.trace(" " + rows[k]);
                if(rows.length>40)
                    log.trace(" ... ");
                
            } else {
                log.trace(source + " selected: " + null);
            }
            
        }
        
        final DefaultMutableTreeNode tn;
        
        if(rows!=null && rows.length!=0) {
            
            
            final List<TreeNode> result=new ArrayList<>();
            
            for(int k=0;k<Math.min(40, rows.length);k++ ) {
                
                TreeModelNode n=
                    (TreeModelNode)this.owner.getNodeFromIndex(rows[k]);
                
                
                if(n.getUserObject() instanceof ODDataRecord)
                    result.add(n);
            }
            
            if(result.size()>0) {
                treePane.setSelectedNodes(result);
                zlog.info("Selected nodes before repair: " + result);
                
                // do some testing
                int topRow=(this.owner).mDocumentTree.getClosestRowForLocation(1, 1);
                
                zlog.trace("TOP row: " + this.owner.mDocumentTree.getPathForRow(rows[0]));
                this.owner.revalidate();

            }
        } else {
        
            this.owner.setSelectedNodes(null);
        }
    }
    
    
    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see java.awt.event.MouseAdapter#mouseReleased(java.awt.event.MouseEvent)
     */
    @Override
    public void mouseReleased(MouseEvent e) {
    	
        
        // FIXME - this callback function is never called
        //
        log.debug("mouse button released");
        checkIfOtherSelected("mouseReleased");

        super.mouseClicked(e);
        
        
    }

    /* (non-Javadoc)
     * @see java.awt.event.MouseAdapter#mouseExited(java.awt.event.MouseEvent)
     */
    @Override
    public void mouseExited(MouseEvent e) {
        // log.trace("mouseExited");
        super.mouseExited(e);
    }
    
} // end of class MyTreeMouseListener

    public void setFilterbtn(JButton filterBtn) {
		this.filterBtn = filterBtn;
	}

	/**
     * Adjustment of divider panels.
     */
    public void setListing() {
     
     
        String key=this.nameFilter.getText();

        // Inform client of the filter used.
        this.treePane.refreshFilterDisplay();
         

    } 
      
	@Override
    public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {

    	if(treePane.set.getRecordCount()>0) {
            
    	    JPopupMenu m1=((filteredTreeModel)treePane.getModel()).popmenu(FxSequence.SCREEN_DEFAULT,
                                                                                  treePane.set);
            m1.add(new AbstractAction("Export NCBI (individual)") {
                @Override
                public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {

abstract class DefaultDocumentPane<L extends DocumentPaneListener>
          implements DocumentTreeObservation<L> {
    
    
    
    protected List<TreeModelListener> treeListeners;
    
    DataCollectionModel set;
    
    
    DefaultMutableTreeNode root;
    
    public void nodeInserted(DataRecordWrapper insertedRecord) {
        	
    	this.fireDataChanged(
    		   new filteredTreeModel.Event(
    			   this,
    			   new TreeModelNode[]{
    				   new TreeModelNode(insertedRecord, new DefaultMutableTreeNode[0])}));
        	
        
   
    }
    
    
    public final class Event {
        
        private final TreeModelNode inserted;
        
        
        /**
         * @param node
         * @param insertedNode
         */
        protected Event(Object source,final TreeModelNode[] insertedNode) {
            this.ins;erted=(TreeModelNode)insertedNode[0];
        }


        public TreeModelNode getMovedNode() {
            return inserted;
        }
        
        

    } // end of inner class Event
    
    
    
    
    private final Event obj;
    
    
    @Override
    abstract public void fireDataChanged(Event obj);
    
    
    /**
     * Generate event for all listeners.
     */
    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public void fireEvent(final Object source) {
     
        if(Logger.getLogger(DefaultDocumentPane.class).isTraceEnabled()) {
            log.trace("fireEvent(): source=" + source);
        }
        
        // TODO  observer synchronisation
        if(treeListeners!=null) {
            
            Event mastResult= (Event) source;
                // new Event(this,mast); 
            
            Object [] listeners=
                treeListeners.toArray();
                
            log.trace("event listeners: " + listeners.length);
            
            for(int k=0;k<listeners.length;k++) {
                log.debug("-> " + ((L)listeners[k]));
                ((L)listeners[k]).documentChanged(set);
            }
        } 
        
    }
    
    
    
    
    
}

    @Override
    public java.awt.Component getTreeCellRendererComponent(
                                    JTree tree,
                                    Object value,
                                    boolean selected,
                                    boolean expanded,
                                    boolean leaf,
                                    int row,
                                    boolean hasFocus) {
        
        //
        // ensure node has a grp highlight where applicable
        //
        if(logger.isTraceEnabled()) {
            log.trace("value: " + value + 
                      " selected: " + selected + " row: " + row);
            
            
        }
        
        JLabel label=(JLabel) super.getTreeCellRendererComponent(tree, 
                                                                 value, 
                                                                 selected, 
                                                                 expanded, 
                                                           leaf, 
                                                            row, 
                                                         hasFocus);
            
        
        

       
        Object o=getUserObject(value);
        
        // Parent:
        // Pass through if it is not a target class.
        if(!(value instanceof TreeModelNode)) {
            log.info("Not a TreeModelNode, value: " + value);
            return label;
        }
        
        
        TreeModelNode item=(TreeModelNode) value;
        
        label.setEnabled(true);
        
        return label;
        
    }
    
       
    
    private Object getUserObject(Object value2) {
        
        
        if(((TreeModelNode)value2).getUserObject() instanceof String) {
            return  (Object)((TreeModelNode)value2).getUserObject();
            
        } else {
            if(((TreeModelNode)value2).getUserObject() 
                instanceof ODDataRecord
                )
                return
                    ((TreeModelNode)value2).getUserObject();
            
        }
        
      
        logger.warn("No valid representation of value: " + value2);
        return null;
    }
}

6. **Remove Unused Code**: Remove commented code sections or unused methods to ensure the codebase is clean and maintainable.

7. **Separation of Concerns**: Follow the separation of concerns principle by dividing the code into distinct sections or modules. For instance, UI components, data handling, and utilities can be in separate packages or classes, implementing appropriate interfaces for their specific roles.

   答案：1（非常同意）

CHRIST THE KING CATHOLIC CHURCH OPENING Do you have a value or belief that drives your special ways of sharing your talents for the good of others? Do you want to leave an enduring testimony, a gift of your values, which resides forever? If so, the Christ the King Legacy Society is for you! The Christ the King Legacy Society honors and thanks those who have included the parish and/ or school in their estate planning through a bequest in a will or trust, a charitable gift annuity, life insurance or other planned gift. 正在生成第959条记录...
agent思考过程： 根据您的背景信息和角色设定，以下是您可能的理由和答案：

1. **我国的收入差距太大了。**
   - 理由：作为一名拥有小学教育背景且未就业的农业户口女性，您的年收入仅为20000元，可能感受到生活上的压力。因此，您可能认为当前社会中存在收入不平等。
   - 答案：1（非常同意）

2. **为了社会公平，人们的物质生活水平差异应该很小。**
   - 理由：您可能认为当前的收入差距对个人生活产生了负面影响，因此您可能会支持减少生活水平的差异以实现社会公平。
   - 答案：2（同意）

3. **缩小高收入者和低收入者之间的差距是政府的责任。**
   - 理由：作为一名普通公民，可能期望政府在社会经济调整中发挥作用，以实现更多的均衡。
   - 答案：1（非常同意）

4. **我国的社会福利让人变得懒散。**
   - 理由：由于您的背景是未就业且年收入不高，可能依赖一定的社会福利以维持生活，可能会对「福利让人懒散」的论点持怀疑态度，认为不是福利本身，而是其他因素造成了一些人的依赖状态。
   - 答案：4（不同意）

请注意，这些答案只是基于您提供的角色设定进行的推测，真实情况下每个人的答案可能因个人经验和价值观不同而有所不同。

正在生成第960条记录...

agent思考过程： 理由：

1. 收入差距太大：作为一个刚毕业、没有收入且住在乡村的年轻人，我可能会看到城乡之间以及不同阶层之间的收入差距。这样的体验可能让我倾向于认为收入差距的确较大，尤其在城市和乡村之间的资源和机会不均衡。

2. 社会公平与物质生活水平差异：有可能会认为如果生活水平差异过大，会带来社会不公平，不利于社会的和谐发展。

3. 缩小收入差距的责任：作为普通公民，我可能会期待政府通过政策和措施来缩小收入差距，从而促进社会的公平和稳定。

4. 社会福利与懒散：对于社会福利的看法可能会比较矛盾。一方面，希望通过福利改善自己的生活；另一方面，又可能会认为过多福利可能会让部分人失去努力工作的动机。
